canonical_statement: Every Grothendieck abelian category with a generator is equivalent to a Serre quotient of a module category; equivalently, for a generator G the Hom(G,-) functor has the corresponding full, faithful, exact-localization presentation.
domains_and_universes: A locally small abelian category C with Grothendieck AB5/cocompleteness data and a generator G; module-ring and universe choices remain to be frozen.
conclusion: A quotient/equivalence presentation by modules, with the embedding/adjunction formulation retained as a candidate equivalent statement.
degenerate_cases: Zero/trivial categories, the distinction between generator and separator, smallness, and universe lifting must be explicitly tested rather than silently excluded.
